name: Mudskipper Point
accessNote: Mudskipper Point is south of Rimmington on the south-western coast. Mogres hide in the sand and must be lured out with a fishing explosive used on the mud patches; Skippy and the Mogres must be complete. The Slayer task/Ogres table (pageid 298279) lists Mudskipper Point mogres as cannonable (3 spawns), and the Mogre page documents a halberd/cannon safespot.
